name: Platform
description: The platform's own DNA: who operates it, the people it knows, and the roles it grants. A tenant organization is a record the host creates at registration, not an instance written here; the operator and its roles are.

entities.name: Organization
entities.description: A tenant of the platform, or the platform's operator.

entities.name: Person
entities.description: A person the identity port resolves. The agent acts for one; a claim is made by one.

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: The identity port's subject for the person.

entities.name: Role
entities.description: A role the platform grants. What it permits is policy, not code.

instances.name: DNA admin
instances.description: Operates the platform. Reads registration and activity across organizations, never another organization's DNA documents.

entities.name: Membership
entities.description: A membership is an entity because the connection between a person and an organization carries a role.

relationships.name: of
relationships.description: The person the membership is for.

relationships.name: in
relationships.description: The organization the membership is in.
